findings.source_quote:
Sometimes the most stirring kind of beauty is found in things we cannot fully comprehend.

There is beauty in weeping of Mary and the disciples around the cross that held the lifeless body of their beloved Master. But when dawn broke on resurrection morning, despair turned into hope and grief into joy.

findings.location: Paragraph on music (translation) — two direct English questions left untranslated
findings.source_quote: The questions have been asked,” Should we always be trying to improve our music making?” and “when have we reached ‘good enough’?”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted rhetorical questions into Norwegian Bokmål to maintain readability and completeness. Suggested translations: 'Bør vi alltid forsøke å forbedre måten vi gjør musikk på?' and 'Når har vi nådd «godt nok»?' Preserve punctuation and quotation marks exactly as in source HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Spørsmålene har blitt stilt: ”Should we always be trying to improve our music making?” og ”when have we reached ‘good enough’?”

findings.source_quote: ...and most of all, the Supreme Being on the throne, all defy our human attempt to grasp and understand the beauty and glory of our God.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct Norwegian grammatical/gender agreement and wording. Replace 'Den høyeste Vesenet' with grammatically correct and idiomatic Norwegian such as 'Det Høyeste Vesen' or better 'Den Høyeste' (capitalization per style) or 'Den høyeste Skaperen' depending on preferred theological tone. Preserve tags and sentence order.
findings.translation_quote: ...og framfor alt, Den høyeste Vesenet på tronen, trosser alle våre menneskelige forsøk på å gripe og forstå Guds skjønnhet og herlighet.

findings.location: Paragraph discussing image of God (translation) — 'et u skapt evig vesen' spacing
findings.source_quote: God is an uncreated eternal being, and man was created in His image to reflect His glory and beauty.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove erroneous space: change 'et u skapt evig vesen' to 'et uskapt, evig vesen' or 'et uskapt evig vesen' and adjust capitalization to fit Norwegian style. Keep HTML unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Gud er et u skapt evig vesen, og mennesket ble skapt i Hans bilde for å gjenspeile Hans herlighet og skjønnhet.
